text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is about to 
begin...! Fine Motion hears about the race 
from her roommate, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race in which Air Groove once ran is a 
magnificent contest filled with pride and 
respect... a special stage truly worthy of 
the title "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion watched the broadcast together 
with the Trainer. She was deeply moved by 
a race where fierce desires to win clashed 
head-on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup— Fine Motion 
committed that name to memory.
